notes.title: ASV Soccer Playtest has ended
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone :)[/p][p]The ASV Soccer Playtest has ended, so I'd wanted to share a few key facts:[/p][list][*][p]We have had a whopping 121 players over the period of slightly more than one month[/p][/*][*][p]Most of those played a couple of matches[/p][/*][*][p]We have had a handful of fans with 2+ hours[/p][/*][*][p]9 players provided feedback[/p][/*][/list][p]Huge thanks to everyone involved. I will now be preparing ASV Soccer for final release later this year. [/p][p]This will mostly include:[/p][list][*][p]Tuning to goalkeepers[/p][/*][*][p]UI Cleanup[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial.[/p][/*][/list][p]See you soon[/p]

notes.title: ASV Soccer playtest available now!
notes.content:
[p]I am happy to announce that the ASV Soccer playtest is available for all players. You will be able to enjoy the full game for free, and invite up to three friends for one month, starting now.[/p][p][/p][h2]What is ASV Soccer?[/h2][p]ASV Soccer is an up to 22 player arcade multiplayer soccer game for true 11 vs 11 matches with seamless drop-in and drop-out. It offers first-person, third-person, and television camera modes, with modern visuals and realistic physics based ball behaviour.[/p][p][/p][h2]Things to know about this Playtest[/h2][p]The current playtest represents the full, latest, and thoroughly tested development status of ASV Soccer. The game is ~90% feature complete and I am looking for testing, balancing, and finding hidden issues. A few important key factsr:[/p][list][*][p]Most players who played AAA soccer games in the past should feel at home with the controls. The game currently does not offer an ingame tutorial, but does display extensive ingame hints by default. Please pay attention to them.[/p][/*][*][p]The game has been tested with up to 10 players, and all metrics point towards the game being hostable on a Steam-Deck spec machine for 22 players. Nevertheless, issues can occur. Please report them through the ingame feedback function, a fix should arrive promptly.[/p][/*][*][p]Even though the current gameplay mix is decently balanced, buffs / debuffs to game mechanics, AI behaviour and other balancing efforts are WIP until game release later this year.[/p][/*][*][p]ASV Soccer is best played with friends or with others. Use the ingame server browser functionality or invite / join through your Steam friends list.[/p][/*][*][p]The playtest will run from June 6th 2025 until August 7th 2025[/p][/*][*][p]The game is a hobby project and developed by one person in my freetime. Please respect that this cannot live up to the scope and standards of other bigger titles. I do hope you enjoy what it offers, but if not - thanks for trying it out anyway.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Feedback gets Free key[/h2][p]The first 100 players to submit valid (non-troll, showing signs of having actually played the game) feedback will get a free Steam key after the playtest period is over, and will be able to continue playing the latest development builds of ASV soccer until game release. The key will stay valid after game release.[/p][h2]
Big thank you to everyone who supports this game, you rock![/h2][h2][/h2]
